description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $70 - $100 per hour 
 
 Full-time commitment of approximately 40 hours per week .
 Availability to work consistently during weekdays.
 Ability to independently develop, review, and evaluate complex scientific research problems.
 Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities, with exceptional attention to scientific accuracy.
 Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams comprising drug discovery scientists, translational researchers, AI specialists, and engineers.
 
 Join a leading AI lab's cutting-edge Generative AI team and contribute to developing and improving foundational AI models from the ground up. We are seeking experienced PhD-level Drug Discovery Scientists and Translational Research Experts from the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries with deep expertise in drug discovery, molecular biology, target identification, pharmacology, and preclinical-to-clinical development.
 In this role, you will leverage your scientific and industry experience to help train and evaluate advanced AI models by developing complex scientific problems, validating research-based solutions, and providing expert-level feedback.
 Your expertise will contribute to improving AI capabilities across drug target identification and validation, assay development, screening strategies, lead optimization, biomarker discovery, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and translational research.
 This is a full-time engagement of approximately 40 hours per week , with the opportunity to work with a leading AI research lab as part of its extended scientific workforce.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Improve AI Model Performance: Guide AI research and engineering teams in identifying scientific knowledge gaps and improving model capabilities across drug discovery, target biology, pharmacology, and translational science.
 Develop Scientific Research Tasks: Design challenging, real-world drug discovery and translational research problems, including target validation strategies, assay development, screening cascades, lead optimization, and biomarker selection.
 Evaluate AI-Generated Scientific Outputs: Review AI-generated research responses, hypotheses, experimental designs, and scientific interpretations for accuracy, rigor, and practical applicability.
 Assess Target Identification and Validation: Evaluate strategies for identifying novel therapeutic targets, validating biological mechanisms, and establishing target relevance to specific disease pathways.
 Review Assay Development and Screening: Assess experimental approaches involving biochemical and cellular assays, high-throughput screening, hit identification, and lead characterization.
 Evaluate Lead Optimization Strategies: Review scientific approaches involving medicinal chemistry, structure-activity relationships (SAR), drug properties, ADME, and drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (DMPK).
 Assess Biomarker and Translational Strategies: Evaluate biomarker identification, validation, patient stratification, and the translation of preclinical findings into clinical development strategies.
 Review Preclinical-to-Clinical Development: Assess PK/PD models, preclinical efficacy and safety findings, first-in-human dose rationale, and early clinical development considerations.
 Develop Evaluation Frameworks: Create detailed scientific guidelines and scoring rubrics to assess hypothesis quality, experimental design, data interpretation, biological reasoning, and translational relevance.
 Provide Expert Scientific Feedback: Identify inaccuracies, unsupported assumptions, and gaps in AI-generated scientific responses and provide clear, actionable recommendations.
 Collaborate with AI Research Teams: Work alongside AI researchers, engineers, and other scientific experts to ensure consistency, scientific accuracy, and quality across AI training and evaluation datasets.
 Core Qualifications
 7+ years of dedicated professional industry experience in Drug Discovery, Translational Science, Pharmaceutical Research, or Biotechnology, beyond doctoral and postdoctoral training.
 PhD or MD/PhD in a relevant scientific discipline such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Pharmacology, Biochemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Chemistry, or a related field.
 Strong experience working within established pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology organizations, leading Contract Research Organizations (CROs), or regulatory agencies.
 Hands-on expertise in at least one or more of the following domains:
 Target Identification and Validation: Target biology, disease mechanisms, molecular pathways, and therapeutic target validation.
 Assay Development and Screening: Biochemical and cellular assay development, high-throughput screening, hit identification, and validation.
 Lead Optimization: Medicinal chemistry, structure-activity relationships (SAR), ADME, DMPK, and candidate optimization.
 Biomarker Discovery: Biomarker identification, validation, clinical relevance, and patient stratification strategies.
 Preclinical-to-Clinical Translation: PK/PD modeling, preclinical efficacy and safety assessment, first-in-human dose selection, and clinical translation.
 Previous experience in independent scientific research, experimental strategy development, and cross-functional drug development programs within an industry setting.
 Currently or most recently working at Associate Director, Principal Scientist, Senior Manager, Director, or equivalent senior scientific leadership level.
 Demonstrable career progression within pharmaceutical or biotechnology research organizations.
 Strong understanding of drug development pipelines, experimental methodologies, scientific data interpretation, and regulatory considerations.
 Experience with AI-assisted scientific research, AI model training, evaluation, or generative AI tools in drug discovery is an added advantage.
 Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex scientific concepts, research findings, and experimental reasoning clearly.
 Preferred Industry Background
 Candidates with experience at established pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or regulatory organizations are preferred.
 Relevant organizations may include:
 Pharmaceutical Companies: Pfizer, Merck, Roche, Novartis, AstraZeneca, Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, Eli Lilly, Bristol Myers Squibb, Sanofi, and GSK.
 Biotechnology Companies: Amgen, Gilead Sciences, Genentech, Regeneron, Vertex Pharmaceuticals, and Biogen.
 Contract Research Organizations: IQVIA, ICON, Parexel, Syneos Health, PPD/Thermo Fisher, Labcorp/Fortrea, and Medpace.
 Regulatory Organizations: FDA and EMA.
 
 Ideal Candidate Profile
 The ideal candidate is a senior-level PhD scientist with substantial pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience and a strong track record in drug discovery or translational research.
 You should possess deep scientific expertise, practical knowledge of drug development workflows, and the ability to evaluate complex biological hypotheses, experimental strategies, and preclinical-to-clinical translation challenges.
